items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Schefter primary source; Eagles report and Rapoport corroboration of full participants.
items.implication: Full workloads expected; no lingering stinger concern for Barkley.
items.opportunity: Barkley lead back snaps/carries/red-zone; Smith full WR routes/targets.

items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams (hamstring) for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent cleared steps to practice, questionable.
items.why: Schefter/Bears PR official; Bagent full participant but still Q.
items.implication: Bagent or other backup starts; CHI pass game downgraded, run game potentially more featured.
items.opportunity: Swift/others may see more if game script allows; reverse Williams-dependent upside.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday Night Football; ETR injury roundup flags him as key absence with prior hip/groin issues and no practice progress.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday list; McVay comments on limited progress, expected back Week 4 barring setback.
items.implication: Davante Adams elevated to high-end WR1; secondary targets rise in Rams offense.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets spike; TE Terrance Ferguson more involved.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 3 vs Colts after missing all practices; second straight absence.
items.why: ETR OUT list; confirmed by multiple reports of DNP all week and official ruling.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz retains elevated TE1 role with ~28-30% target share.
items.opportunity: Schultz routes/targets; other HOU WRs (Hutchinson/Boutte) volume up but lower efficiency.

items.text: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman (high-ankle) to short-term IR, miss next few games; expected back late October vs ARI.
items.why: Schefter source; Rapoport notes hit to DEN RB depth with Dobbins/Harvey returning.
items.implication: Clears path for Dobbins/Harvey lead if healthy; no Coleman handcuff value short-term.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags; clarity hoped early on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: Levitan player-specific: usage data and limited practice indicators support playing; DFS implications big.
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers as normal; monitor Flowers hamstring closely for early window.
items.opportunity: Full roles expected if active; reverse stale OUT beneficiaries.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT; Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) projected as lead back with checkdowns and volume bump.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Levitan notes Warren lead + checkdowns opportunity.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex upgrade with expanded snaps/carries/routes.
items.opportunity: Warren snap share and pass-game work expands significantly.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); Mariota expected to start for Commanders.
items.why: ETR OUT list corroborated by Schefter/Rapoport reports of dislocation and not IR but multi-week.
items.implication: McLaurin target share holds ~25% historically with Mariota but tough SEA matchup and low team total.
items.opportunity: Limited for WAS pass catchers; reverse any prior Daniels-dependent boosts.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks OUT (core, IR expected); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back.
items.why: ETR OUT; Berry notes IR push and Hubbard RB14 utilization already.
items.implication: Hubbard every-week RB2 with full lead role and Dillon as primary backup.

items.text: IN: JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Malik Nabers, Travis Etienne, Jadarian Price (among others); clarity on early Qs pending.
items.implication: Dobbins/Harvey Broncos committee return; Nabers full; Etienne limited role per Berry; Price Seahawks back.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snaps for Nabers/Price; Broncos RBs split but available.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Usage spike confirmed in 10 Facts (30% routes targeted); Collins OUT again.
items.opportunity: High target share and red-zone potential.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Matchup and prop data; volume expected high.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start with smash spot.
items.opportunity: Carries and goal-line work vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps and 5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/game to RBs.
items.why: 10 Facts: Henderson 65% snaps and 16-5 touch edge post-fumble; tough matchup.
items.implication: Sit or fade Stevenson; Henderson rising but still ranks Stevenson ahead for now.
items.opportunity: Henderson role expansion in pass pro and touches.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead despite usage shift.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches and 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara active; role not there (RB37 util).
items.why: Split backfield usage data; ETR lists him IN but limited role.
items.implication: Sit in most formats; prefer other NO options if any.

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: fewest fantasy pts to WRs allowed, 7.9 ypr; WAS lowest implied total (17); Daniels OUT.
items.why: Matchup + QB change + team total; 10 Facts notes 25% share historically with Mariota but still fade this week.
items.opportunity: Target share may hold but efficiency tanks.

items.text: Drake London averages >20 PPR, 35% target share, 97 rec yds in 12 career games with Michael Penix.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start if Penix plays.
items.opportunity: High target share and production expected.
